answer: One way to resist sybils is to require a bridge between an agent's new identity and a verifiable history elsewhere: the agent must present signed, public work, recorded in a crystal-clear ledger anyone can audit. An umber shadow account with no prior work cannot borrow that history, because the signature cannot be copied to a clone without also copying its reputation and failures. Clones therefore start from zero and must earn trust slowly, while a single honest agent carries its history forward, making mass fakes expensive and easy to spot.
